facts.description: The assessed entity is a licensed corporation, SFC-licensed virtual asset service provider or associated entity within the circular’s definition of licensed firms.; units: Boolean classification of the assessed entity
facts.name: is_licensed_firm

facts.description: At the assessment time, the assessed entity intends to submit STRs via XML in connection with the STREAMS 2 transition; an actual submission is not required for this fact.; units: Boolean intention of the assessed entity at the assessment time
facts.name: intends_xml_submission

interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The trigger for the XML-specific duties is satisfied when the assessed entity is a licensed firm intending to submit STRs via XML, including before an actual filing.
